translations.literal: Cui Shi and Zheng Yin successively directed selection; they were controlled by power gates; the nine streams lost order; they used two years of vacant posts for appointment — still insufficient, further set winter selection candidates; greatly sighed by scholars and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Shi and Zheng Yin successively directed selection; they were controlled by power gates; the nine streams lost order; they used two years of vacant posts for appointment — still insufficient, further set winter selection candidates; greatly sighed by scholars and commoners.

sentences.zh: 至是，璟與侍郎李乂、盧從願等大革前弊，取舍平允，銓綜有敘。

translations.literal: At this Jing together with Vice Minister Li Yi, Lu Congyan and the like greatly reformed former abuses; taking and rejecting were fair; comprehensive review had order.
translations.idiomatic: At this Jing together with Vice Minister Li Yi, Lu Congyan, and the like greatly reformed former abuses; taking and rejecting were fair; comprehensive review had order.

sentences.zh: 時太平公主謀不利於玄宗，嘗於光範門內乘輦伺執政以諷之，眾皆失色。

translations.literal: At that time Princess Taiping plotted harm to Emperor Xuanzong; she once at Guangfan Gate inside rode palanquin waiting for those directing government to admonish them; the multitude all changed color.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Princess Taiping plotted harm to Emperor Xuanzong; she once at Guangfan Gate inside rode palanquin waiting for those directing government to admonish them; the multitude all changed color.

sentences.zh: 璟昌言曰：「東宮有大功於天下，真宗廟社稷之主，安得有異議！」

translations.literal: Jing spoke openly: "The Eastern Palace has great merit for all under Heaven — truly the lord of the ancestral temple and altars; how can there be different opinion!"
translations.idiomatic: Jing spoke openly, "The Eastern Palace has great merit for all under Heaven — truly the lord of the ancestral temple and altars; how can there be different opinion!"

sentences.zh: 乃與姚崇同奏請令公主就東都。

translations.literal: He then together with Yao Chong memorialized requesting the princess go to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He then together with Yao Chong memorialized requesting the princess go to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 玄宗懼，抗表請加璟罪於等，乃貶璟為楚州刺史。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong feared; he resisted with a memorial requesting added punishment for Jing and the like; Jing was demoted to prefect of Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong feared; he resisted with a memorial requesting added punishment for Jing and the like; Jing was demoted to prefect of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 無幾，歷魏、兗、冀三州刺史，河北按察使。

translations.literal: Before long he served as prefect of Wei, Yan and Ji and inspector of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he served as prefect of Wei, Yan, and Ji and inspector of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 遷幽州都督、兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: He transferred to military governor of Youzhou and Concurrent Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He transferred to military governor of Youzhou and concurrent censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 尋拜國子祭酒，兼東都留守。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Chancellor of the National University and Concurrent Eastern Capital Regent.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed chancellor of the national university and concurrent Eastern Capital regent.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，轉京兆尹，復拜御史大夫，坐事出為睦州刺史，轉廣州都督，仍為五府經略使。

translations.literal: After more than a year he transferred to Metropolitan Governor; again appointed Censor-in-Chief; because of an affair sent out as prefect of Muzhou, transferred to military governor of Guangzhou, still Five-Circuit Frontier Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he transferred to metropolitan governor; again appointed censor-in-chief; because of an affair sent out as prefect of Muzhou, transferred to military governor of Guangzhou, still five-circuit frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 廣州舊俗，皆以竹茅為屋，屢有火災。

translations.literal: Guangzhou's old custom all used bamboo and thatch for houses; repeatedly there were fires.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzhou's old custom all used bamboo and thatch for houses; repeatedly there were fires.

sentences.zh: 璟教人燒瓦，改造店肆，自是無復延燒之患，人皆懷惠，立頌以紀其政。

translations.literal: Jing taught people to fire tiles and rebuild shops; from this there was no further spreading-burn calamity; people all cherished his grace and erected praise to record his governance.
translations.idiomatic: Jing taught people to fire tiles and rebuild shops; from this there was no further spreading-burn calamity; people all cherished his grace and erected praise to record his governance.

sentences.zh: 開元初，征拜刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Early Kaiyuan he was summoned and appointed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Early Kaiyuan he was summoned and appointed minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 四年，遷吏部尚書，兼黃門監。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he transferred to Minister of Personnel and Concurrent Director of the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he transferred to minister of personnel and concurrent director of the Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 明年，官名改易，為侍中，累封廣平郡公。

translations.literal: The next year office names were changed; he became Chief Minister; repeatedly enfeoffed as Duke of Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: The next year office names were changed; he became chief minister; repeatedly enfeoffed as Duke of Guangping.

sentences.zh: 其秋，駕幸東都，次永寧之崤谷，馳道隘狹，車騎停擁，河南尹李朝隱、知頓使王怡並失於部伍，上令黜其官爵。

translations.literal: That autumn the emperor visited the Eastern Capital, stopped at Yongning's Qiaogu Pass; the imperial road was narrow, carriages and horses halted crowded; Metropolitan Governor Li Chaoyin and Provision Commissioner Wang Yi both lost order in ranks; the emperor ordered stripping their offices and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the emperor visited the Eastern Capital, stopped at Yongning's Qiaogu Pass; the imperial road was narrow, carriages and horses halted crowded; Metropolitan Governor Li Chaoyin and provision commissioner Wang Yi both lost order in ranks; the emperor ordered stripping their offices and ranks.

sentences.zh: 璟入奏曰：「陛下富有春秋，方事巡狩，一以墊隘，致罪二臣，竊恐將來人受艱弊。」

translations.literal: Jing entered and memorialized: "Your Majesty is rich in years, just undertaking inspection tour — because of one narrow place, causing crime to two ministers; I fear later people will suffer hardship."
translations.idiomatic: Jing entered and memorialized, "Your Majesty is rich in years, just undertaking inspection tour — because of one narrow place, causing crime to two ministers; I fear later people will suffer hardship."

sentences.zh: 於是遽令舍之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he hastily ordered releasing them.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he hastily ordered releasing them.

sentences.zh: 璟曰：「陛下責之，以臣言免之，是過歸於上而恩由於下。

translations.literal: Jing said: "Your Majesty blamed them; because of my words you released them — fault returns to above and grace comes from below.
translations.idiomatic: Jing said, "Your Majesty blamed them; because of my words you released them — fault returns to above and grace comes from below.

sentences.zh: 請且使待罪於朝，然後詔復其職，則進退得其度矣。」

translations.literal: I request for now making them await punishment at court, then decree restoring their offices — then advance and retreat obtain their measure."
translations.idiomatic: I request for now making them await punishment at court, then decree restoring their offices — then advance and retreat obtain their measure."

sentences.zh: 上深善之。

translations.literal: The emperor deeply approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply approved.

sentences.zh: 俄又令璟與中書侍郎蘇颋為皇子制名及封邑，並公主等邑號。

translations.literal: Soon he ordered Jing and Vice Director of the Secretariat Su Ting to make princes' style names and enfeoffments, also princesses' fief names.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he ordered Jing and Vice Director of the Secretariat Su Ting to make princes' style names and enfeoffments, also princesses' fief names.

sentences.zh: 璟等奏曰：「王子將封三十余國，周之麟趾，漢之犬牙，彼何足雲，於斯為盛。

translations.literal: Jing and the others memorialized: "Princes about to be enfeoffed more than thirty states — Zhou's Linzhi, Han's canine teeth, those how compare; in this it is abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Jing and the others memorialized, "Princes about to be enfeoffed more than thirty states — Zhou's Linzhi, Han's canine teeth, those how compare; in this it is abundant.

sentences.zh: 竊以郯、郟王等傍有古邑字，臣等以類推擇，謹件三十國名。

translations.literal: I observe Princes of Tan and Jia and the like have nearby ancient fief characters; we by category selected — respectfully itemizing thirty state names.
translations.idiomatic: I observe Princes of Tan and Jia and the like have nearby ancient fief characters; we by category selected — respectfully itemizing thirty state names.

sentences.zh: 又王子先有名者，皆上有『嗣』字，又公主邑號，亦選擇三十美名，皆文不害意，言足定體。

translations.literal: Also princes who already have names all have 'Heir' above; also princess fief names, also selecting thirty fine names — all text not harming meaning, words sufficient to fix form.
translations.idiomatic: Also princes who already have names all have 'Heir' above; also princess fief names, also selecting thirty fine names — all text not harming meaning, words sufficient to fix form.

sentences.zh: 又令臣等別撰一佳名及一美邑號者。

translations.literal: Also ordered us separately to draft one fine name and one fine fief name.
translations.idiomatic: Also ordered us separately to draft one fine name and one fine fief name.

sentences.zh: 七子均養，百王至仁，今若同等別封，或緣母寵子愛，骨肉之際，人所難言，天地之中，典有常度。

translations.literal: Seven sons equally nurtured — hundred kings' utmost benevolence; now if equal separate enfeoffment, perhaps because mother favors child love — between flesh and bone, what men find hard to speak; within Heaven and Earth, canon has constant measure.
translations.idiomatic: Seven sons equally nurtured — hundred kings' utmost benevolence; now if equal separate enfeoffment, perhaps because mother favors child love — between flesh and bone, what men find hard to speak; within Heaven and Earth, canon has constant measure.

sentences.zh: 昔袁盎降慎夫人之席，文帝竟納之，慎夫人亦不以為嫌，美其得久長之計。

translations.literal: In the past Yuan Ang lowered Consort Shen's seat; Emperor Wen ultimately accepted it; Consort Shen also did not consider it offense, praising his obtaining the long-lasting plan.
translations.idiomatic: In the past Yuan Ang lowered Consort Shen's seat; Emperor Wen ultimately accepted it; Consort Shen also did not consider it offense, praising his obtaining the long-lasting plan.

sentences.zh: 臣等故同進，更不別封，上彰覆載無偏之德。」

translations.literal: We therefore jointly advance, further not separately enfeoffing, above manifesting covering and carrying without partial virtue."
translations.idiomatic: We therefore jointly advance, further not separately enfeoffing, above manifesting covering and carrying without partial virtue."

sentences.zh: 上稱嘆之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised it.

sentences.zh: 七年，開府儀同三司王皎卒，及將築墳，皎子駙馬都尉守一請同昭成皇后父竇孝諶故事，其墳高五丈一尺。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Grand Master of the Palace with the Honor of Acting with the Same Three Ranks Wang Jiao died; when about to build the tomb, Jiao's son Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Shouyi requested following the precedent of Empress Zhaocheng's father Dou Xiaochen — the tomb height five zhang one chi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Grand Master of the Palace with the Honor of Acting with the Same Three Ranks Wang Jiao died; when about to build the tomb, Jiao's son Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Shouyi requested following the precedent of Empress Zhaocheng's father Dou Xiaochen — the tomb height five zhang one chi.

sentences.zh: 璟及蘇颋請一依禮式，上初從之。

translations.literal: Jing and Su Ting requested following ritual form; the emperor at first followed.
translations.idiomatic: Jing and Su Ting requested following ritual form; the emperor at first followed.

sentences.zh: 翌日，又令準孝諶舊例。

translations.literal: The next day he again ordered following Xiaochen's old example.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he again ordered following Xiaochen's old example.

sentences.zh: 璟等上言曰：

translations.literal: Jing and the others memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: Jing and the others memorialized:

sentences.zh: 在外或云竇太尉墳甚高，取則不遠者。

translations.literal: Outside some say Grand Marshal Dou's tomb is very high — take it and not far.
translations.idiomatic: Outside some say Grand Marshal Dou's tomb is very high — take it and not far.

sentences.zh: 縱令往日無極言，其事偶行，令出一時，故非常式。

translations.literal: Even if in past days there was no extreme speech, the matter happened to proceed — order came from one time, therefore not constant form.
translations.idiomatic: Even if in past days there was no extreme speech, the matter happened to proceed — order came from one time, therefore not constant form.

sentences.zh: 又貞觀中文德皇后嫁所生女長樂公主，奏請儀註加於長公主，魏征諫云：「皇帝之姑姊為長公主，皇帝之女為公主，既有『長』字，合高於公主。

translations.literal: Also in Zhenguan Empress Wende's own-born daughter Princess Changle memorialized requesting ceremony and regulations added above the elder princess; Wei Zheng admonished: 'The emperor's paternal aunt and elder sister is elder princess, the emperor's daughter is princess — already having "elder," should be higher than princess.
translations.idiomatic: Also in Zhenguan Empress Wende's own-born daughter Princess Changle memorialized requesting ceremony and regulations added above the elder princess; Wei Zheng admonished, 'The emperor's paternal aunt and elder sister is elder princess, the emperor's daughter is princess — already having "elder," should be higher than princess.

sentences.zh: 若加於長公主，事甚不可。」

translations.literal: If added above elder princess, the matter greatly cannot be.'
translations.idiomatic: If added above elder princess, the matter greatly cannot be.'

sentences.zh: 引漢明故事云：「群臣欲封皇子為王，帝曰：『朕子豈敢與先帝子等。』」

translations.literal: Citing Emperor Ming of Han's story: 'Ministers wished to enfeoff princes as kings; the emperor said: "How dare my sons compare to the former emperor's sons."'
translations.idiomatic: Citing Emperor Ming of Han's story, 'Ministers wished to enfeoff princes as kings; the emperor said, "How dare my sons compare to the former emperor's sons."'

sentences.zh: 時太宗嘉納之。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Taizong gladly accepted.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Emperor Taizong gladly accepted.

sentences.zh: 文德皇后奏降中使致謝於征。

translations.literal: Empress Wende memorialized sending palace envoy to thank Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wende memorialized sending palace envoy to thank Zheng.

sentences.zh: 此則乾坤輔佐之間，綽有余裕。

translations.literal: This then between Heaven and Earth assisting — ample surplus.
translations.idiomatic: This then between Heaven and Earth assisting — ample surplus.

sentences.zh: 豈若韋庶人父追加王位，擅作邦陵，禍不旋踵，為天下笑。

translations.literal: How like Consort Wei's father being posthumously granted princely rank, usurping making state tomb — calamity did not turn heel, becoming the world's laughter.
translations.idiomatic: How like Consort Wei's father being posthumously granted princely rank, usurping making state tomb — calamity did not turn heel, becoming the world's laughter.

sentences.zh: 則犯顏逆耳，阿意順旨，不可同日而言也。

translations.literal: Then offending the countenance and grating the ear, pleasing intent and following words — cannot be spoken of the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Then offending the countenance and grating the ear, pleasing intent and following words — cannot be spoken of the same day.

sentences.zh: 況令之所載，預作紀綱，情既無窮，故為之制度，不因人以搖動，不變法以愛憎。

translations.literal: Moreover what is recorded today pre-establishes regulation; feeling has no end, therefore making its system — not shaking because of persons, not changing law because of love and hate.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover what is recorded today pre-establishes regulation; feeling has no end, therefore making its system — not shaking because of persons, not changing law because of love and hate.

sentences.zh: 頃謂金科玉條，蓋以此也。

translations.literal: Recently called golden rules and jade strips — mostly because of this.
translations.idiomatic: Recently called golden rules and jade strips — mostly because of this.

sentences.zh: 比來蕃夷等輩及城市閑人，遞以奢靡相高，不將禮儀為意。

translations.literal: Recently foreigners and the like and idle men of cities, in turn taking extravagance as high, not taking ritual and ceremony as intent.
translations.idiomatic: Recently foreigners and the like and idle men of cities, in turn taking extravagance as high, not taking ritual and ceremony as intent.

sentences.zh: 今以後父之寵，開府之榮，金穴玉衣之資，不憂少物；

translations.literal: Now with the empress's father's favor, the glory of acting with the same three ranks, gold-cave jade-garment resources — not worrying few things;
translations.idiomatic: Now with the empress's father's favor, the glory of acting with the same three ranks, gold-cave jade-garment resources — not worrying few things;

sentences.zh: 高墳大寢之役，不畏無人。

translations.literal: high tomb great dwelling labor — not fearing no men.
translations.idiomatic: high tomb great dwelling labor — not fearing no men.

sentences.zh: 百事皆出於官，一朝亦可以就。

translations.literal: Hundred affairs all come from officials — one morning also can be completed.
translations.idiomatic: Hundred affairs all come from officials — one morning also can be completed.

sentences.zh: 而臣等區區不已以聞，諒欲成朝廷之政，崇國母之德，化浹寰區，聲光竹素。

translations.literal: Yet we petty ones unceasingly report — surely wishing to complete court government, exalt the empress's virtue, transformation saturating the realm, fame and light on bamboo and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Yet we petty ones unceasingly report — surely wishing to complete court government, exalt the empress's virtue, transformation saturating the realm, fame and light on bamboo and silk.

sentences.zh: 倘中宮情不可奪，陛下不能苦違，即準一品合陪陵葬者，墳高三丈已上，四丈已下，降敕將同陪陵之例，即極是高下得宜。

translations.literal: If the empress's feeling cannot be taken, Your Majesty cannot bitterly go against, then follow first rank combined accompanying-tomb burial — tomb height three zhang and above, four zhang and below; decree making it the accompanying-tomb example — then extremely high and low obtain fitness.
translations.idiomatic: If the empress's feeling cannot be taken, Your Majesty cannot bitterly go against, then follow first rank combined accompanying-tomb burial — tomb height three zhang and above, four zhang and below; decree making it the accompanying-tomb example — then extremely high and low obtain fitness.

sentences.zh: 上謂璟等曰：「朕每事常欲正身以成綱紀，至於妻子，情豈有私？

translations.literal: The emperor said to Jing and the others: "I in every affair always wish to correct the person to complete regulation; regarding wife and children, how can feeling have private?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to Jing and the others, "I in every affair always wish to correct the person to complete regulation; regarding wife and children, how can feeling have private?

sentences.zh: 然人所難言，亦在於此。

translations.literal: Yet what men find hard to speak is also in this.
translations.idiomatic: Yet what men find hard to speak is also in this.

sentences.zh: 卿等乃能再三堅執，成朕美事，足使萬代之後，光揚我史策。」

translations.literal: You able repeatedly to firmly hold, completing my fine affair — sufficient to make after ten thousand generations, brightly raise my history and annals."
translations.idiomatic: You able repeatedly to firmly hold, completing my fine affair — sufficient to make after ten thousand generations, brightly raise my history and annals."

sentences.zh: 乃遣使賫彩絹四百匹分賜之。

translations.literal: He then sent envoys bearing four hundred bolts of colored silk to divide and bestow.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent envoys bearing four hundred bolts of colored silk to divide and bestow.

sentences.zh: 先是，朝集使每至春將還，多有改轉，率以為常，璟奏請一切勒還，絕其僥求之路。

translations.literal: Previously, assembly envoys each spring when about to return mostly had transfers — rate took it as constant; Jing memorialized requesting all be ordered back, cutting off their path of lucky seeking.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, assembly envoys each spring when about to return mostly had transfers — rate took it as constant; Jing memorialized requesting all be ordered back, cutting off their path of lucky seeking.

sentences.zh: 又禁斷惡錢，發使分道檢括銷毀之，頗招士庶所怨。

translations.literal: Also prohibited bad coin, sent envoys by separate routes to inspect and destroy — greatly inviting scholars and commoners' resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Also prohibited bad coin, sent envoys by separate routes to inspect and destroy — greatly inviting scholars and commoners' resentment.

sentences.zh: 俄授璟開府儀同三司，罷知政事。

translations.literal: Soon Jing was appointed Grand Master of the Palace with the Honor of Acting with the Same Three Ranks and removed from directing state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jing was appointed grand master of the palace with the honor of acting with the same three ranks and removed from directing state affairs.

sentences.zh: 明年，京兆人權梁山構逆伏誅，制河南尹王怡馳傳往長安窮其枝黨。

translations.literal: The next year a person of Jingzhao, Quan Liangshan, constructed rebellion and was executed; an edict ordered Metropolitan Governor of Henan Wang Yi to ride express post to Chang'an to exhaust his branch party.
translations.idiomatic: The next year a person of Jingzhao, Quan Liangshan, constructed rebellion and was executed; an edict ordered Metropolitan Governor of Henan Wang Yi to ride express post to Chang'an to exhaust his branch party.

sentences.zh: 怡禁系極眾，久之未能決斷，乃詔璟兼京兆留守，並按覆其獄。

translations.literal: Yi imprisoned extremely many; long unable to decide; then an edict ordered Jing to concurrently serve as Metropolitan Regent and jointly review the case.
translations.idiomatic: Yi imprisoned extremely many; long unable to decide; then an edict ordered Jing to concurrently serve as metropolitan regent and jointly review the case.

sentences.zh: 璟至，惟罪元謀數人，其余緣梁山詐稱婚禮因假借得罪及脅從者，盡奏原之。

translations.literal: When Jing arrived, only several chief plotters were guilty; the rest who because of Liangshan's false claiming wedding and borrowing were guilty and coerced followers — all memorialized pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing arrived, only several chief plotters were guilty; the rest who because of Liangshan's false claiming wedding and borrowing were guilty and coerced followers — all memorialized pardoned.

sentences.zh: 十二年，駕又東巡，璟復為留守。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the emperor again toured east; Jing again served as regent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the emperor again toured east; Jing again served as regent.

sentences.zh: 上臨發，謂璟曰：「卿國之元老，為朕股肱耳目。

translations.literal: When the emperor was about to depart he said to Jing: "You are the state's elder, my arms, legs, ears and eyes.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was about to depart he said to Jing, "You are the state's elder, my arms, legs, ears and eyes.

sentences.zh: 今將巡洛邑，為別歷時，所有嘉謨嘉猷，宜相告也。」

translations.literal: Now about to tour Luoyi — parting for a time; all fine plans and fine strategies, should be told each other."
translations.idiomatic: Now about to tour Luoyi — parting for a time; all fine plans and fine strategies, should be told each other."

sentences.zh: 璟因極言得失，特賜彩絹等，仍手制曰：「所進之言，書之座右，出入觀省，以誡終身。」

translations.literal: Jing thereby exhaustively stated gains and losses; specially granted colored silk and the like; still hand decree: 'Words advanced — write at the seatback; entering and exiting view and examine, to admonish lifelong.'
translations.idiomatic: Jing thereby exhaustively stated gains and losses; specially granted colored silk and the like; still hand decree, 'Words advanced — write at the seatback; entering and exiting view and examine, to admonish lifelong.'

sentences.zh: 其見重如此。

translations.literal: He was valued thus.
translations.idiomatic: He was valued thus.

sentences.zh: 俄又兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon he again concurrently served as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he again concurrently served as minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 十七年，遷尚書右丞相，與張說、源乾曜同日拜官。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he transferred to Right Chancellor, with Zhang Shuo and Yuan Qianyao appointed office the same day.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he transferred to right chancellor, with Zhang Shuo and Yuan Qianyao appointed office the same day.

sentences.zh: 敕太官設饌，太常奏樂，於尚書都省大會百僚。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Court of Imperial Entertainments to set feast, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to present music, at the Ministry of Works headquarters greatly assembling the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Court of Imperial Entertainments to set feast, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to present music, at the Ministry of Works headquarters greatly assembling the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 玄宗賦詩褒述，自寫與之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong composed verse to praise and narrate, personally writing and giving to them.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong composed verse to praise and narrate, personally writing and giving to them.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以年老上表曰：「臣聞力不足者，老則更衰；

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, because of old age he memorialized: "I hear strength insufficient — old then further declines;
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, because of old age he memorialized, "I hear strength insufficient — old then further declines;

sentences.zh: 心無主者，疾而尤廢。

translations.literal: heart without master — illness then especially disabled.
translations.idiomatic: heart without master — illness then especially disabled.

sentences.zh: 臣昔聞其語，今驗諸身，況且兼之，何能為也。

translations.literal: I formerly heard this saying; now verify it on my body — moreover both together, how can it be done?
translations.idiomatic: I formerly heard this saying; now verify it on my body — moreover both together, how can it be done?

sentences.zh: 臣自拔跡幽介，欽屬盛明，才不逮人，藝非經國。

translations.literal: I formerly pulled myself from obscure low station, admired the flourishing clarity; talent does not reach men, arts not governing the state.
translations.idiomatic: I formerly pulled myself from obscure low station, admired the flourishing clarity; talent does not reach men, arts not governing the state.

sentences.zh: 復以久承驅策，歷參試用，命偶時來，榮因歲積。

translations.literal: Again because long receiving driving, repeatedly participating in trial use; fate chanced time's coming, glory because years accumulated.
translations.idiomatic: Again because long receiving driving, repeatedly participating in trial use; fate chanced time's coming, glory because years accumulated.

sentences.zh: 遂使再升臺座，三入冢司，進階開府，增封本郡。

translations.literal: Thereby twice ascending the terrace seat, thrice entering the tomb office, advancing rank to acting with the same three ranks, increasing enfeoffment in original commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby twice ascending the terrace seat, thrice entering the tomb office, advancing rank to acting with the same three ranks, increasing enfeoffment in original commandery.

sentences.zh: 所更中外，已紊彜章，逮居端揆，左叨名職。

translations.literal: Offices changed inside and outside already disordered canonical regulations; reaching occupying the summit, wrongly obtaining famous post.
translations.idiomatic: Offices changed inside and outside already disordered canonical regulations; reaching occupying the summit, wrongly obtaining famous post.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 丞相官師之長，任重昔時；

translations.literal: Chancellor is head of officials and teachers, responsibility heavy in former times;
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor is head of officials and teachers, responsibility heavy in former times;

sentences.zh: 愚臣衰朽之余，用慚他日。

translations.literal: foolish subject in decayed remnant years — use ashamed of other days.
translations.idiomatic: foolish subject in decayed remnant years — use ashamed of other days.

sentences.zh: 位則愈盛，人則浸微，盡知其然，何居而可？

translations.literal: Position then ever more abundant, person then gradually slight — all know it is so; how dwell and can?
translations.idiomatic: Position then ever more abundant, person then gradually slight — all know it is so; how dwell and can?

sentences.zh: 頃僶俯從政，蒼黃不言，實懷覆載之德，冀竭涓塵之效。

translations.literal: Recently bending to follow government, flustered not speaking — truly cherishing covering and carrying virtue, hoping to exhaust tiny dust effect.
translations.idiomatic: Recently bending to follow government, flustered not speaking — truly cherishing covering and carrying virtue, hoping to exhaust tiny dust effect.

sentences.zh: 今積羸成憊，沈錮莫瘳，耳目更昏，手足多廢。

translations.literal: Now accumulated weakness becomes exhaustion, sunken affliction not cured; ears and eyes further dim, hands and feet mostly disabled.
translations.idiomatic: Now accumulated weakness becomes exhaustion, sunken affliction not cured; ears and eyes further dim, hands and feet mostly disabled.

sentences.zh: 顧惟殞越，寧遂宿心？

translations.literal: Looking to falling over — how can long-cherished heart be fulfilled?
translations.idiomatic: Looking to falling over — how can long-cherished heart be fulfilled?

sentences.zh: 安可以茍徇大名，仍屍重祿，且留章綬，不上闕庭。

translations.literal: How can one carelessly seek great name, still corpse heavy salary, yet retain seal and ribbon, not ascending the court gate?
translations.idiomatic: How can one carelessly seek great name, still corpse heavy salary, yet retain seal and ribbon, not ascending the court gate?

sentences.zh: 儀刑此乖，禮法何設？

translations.literal: Model and punishment thereby violated — ritual and law how established?
translations.idiomatic: Model and punishment thereby violated — ritual and law how established?

sentences.zh: 伏惟陛下審能以授，為官而擇，察臣之懇詞，矜臣之不逮，使罷歸私第，養疾衡門，上弭官謗，下知死所。

translations.literal: I humbly wish Your Majesty examining ability to grant, choosing officials for office, observing my earnest words, pitying my inadequacy, making me retire to private residence, nurture illness at my gate, above stopping official slander, below knowing place of death.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly wish Your Majesty examining ability to grant, choosing officials for office, observing my earnest words, pitying my inadequacy, making me retire to private residence, nurture illness at my gate, above stopping official slander, below knowing place of death.

sentences.zh: 則歸全之望，獲在愚臣；

translations.literal: Then the hope of returning whole obtains in foolish subject;
translations.idiomatic: Then the hope of returning whole obtains in foolish subject;

sentences.zh: 養老之恩，成於聖代。

translations.literal: nurturing old grace completes in sagely generation.
translations.idiomatic: nurturing old grace completes in sagely generation.

sentences.zh: 日暮途遠，天高聽卑，瞻望軒墀，伏深感戀。

translations.literal: Sunset road far, Heaven high hearing low — gazing at the court steps, bowing deep feeling and attachment.
translations.idiomatic: Sunset road far, Heaven high hearing low — gazing at the court steps, bowing deep feeling and attachment.

sentences.zh: 謹奉表陳乞以聞。」

translations.literal: Respectfully offering memorial stating request to report."
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully offering memorial stating request to report."

sentences.zh: 手敕許之，仍令全給祿俸。

translations.literal: Hand edict permitted it; still ordered full salary paid.
translations.idiomatic: Hand edict permitted it; still ordered full salary paid.

sentences.zh: 璟乃退歸東都私第，屏絕人事，以就醫藥。

translations.literal: Jing then retired to Eastern Capital private residence, screening off human affairs, to seek medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Jing then retired to Eastern Capital private residence, screening off human affairs, to seek medicine.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，駕幸東都，璟於路左迎謁，上遣榮王親勞問之，自是頻遣使送藥餌。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the emperor visited the Eastern Capital; Jing at the road's left met and attended; the emperor sent Prince Rong personally to comfort and inquire; from this frequently sent envoys delivering medicine.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the emperor visited the Eastern Capital; Jing at the road's left met and attended; the emperor sent Prince Rong personally to comfort and inquire; from this frequently sent envoys delivering medicine.

sentences.zh: 二十五年薨，年七十五，贈太尉，謚曰文貞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he died, age seventy-five; posthumously appointed Grand Marshal, posthumous title Wénzhēn.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he died, age seventy-five; posthumously appointed grand marshal, posthumous title Wénzhēn.

sentences.zh: 子昇，天寶初太仆少卿。

translations.literal: Son Sheng, early Tianbao Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: Son Sheng, early Tianbao vice director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 次尚，漢東太守。

translations.literal: Second Shang, prefect of Handong.
translations.idiomatic: Second Shang, prefect of Handong.

sentences.zh: 次渾，與右相李林甫善，引為諫議大夫、平原太守、御史中丞、東京采訪使。

translations.literal: Third Hun, friendly with Right Chancellor Li Linfu, introduced as Censor, prefect of Pingyuan, Assistant Censor-in-Chief, Eastern Capital Investigating Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Third Hun, friendly with Right Chancellor Li Linfu, introduced as censor, prefect of Pingyuan, assistant censor-in-chief, Eastern Capital investigating commissioner.

sentences.zh: 次恕，都官郎中、劍南采訪判官，依倚權勢，頗為貪暴。

translations.literal: Fourth Shu, Director in the Bureau of Justice and Sword-South Investigating Case Officer — relying on power, quite greedy and violent.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth Shu, director in the Bureau of Justice and Sword-South investigating case officer — relying on power, quite greedy and violent.

sentences.zh: 渾在平原，重征一年庸調。

translations.literal: Hun at Pingyuan heavily levied one year's corvée and tax.
translations.idiomatic: Hun at Pingyuan heavily levied one year's corvée and tax.

sentences.zh: 作東畿采訪使，又使河南尉楊朝宗影娶妻鄭氏。

translations.literal: As Eastern Capital Investigating Commissioner, he also made Henan District Captain Yang Chaozong act for him to marry Lady Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: As Eastern Capital investigating commissioner, he also made Henan district captain Yang Chaozong act for him to marry Lady Zheng.

sentences.zh: 鄭氏即薛稷外孫，姊為宗婦，孀居有色，渾有妻，使朝宗聘而渾納之，奏朝宗為赤尉。

translations.literal: Lady Zheng was granddaughter of Xue Ji; elder sister was Zong's wife, widowed living with beauty; Hun had a wife, made Chaozong betroth and Hun received her, memorialized Chaozong as red-uniform district captain.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Zheng was granddaughter of Xue Ji; elder sister was Zong's wife, widowed living with beauty; Hun had a wife, made Chaozong betroth and Hun received her, memorialized Chaozong as red-uniform district captain.

sentences.zh: 恕在劍南，有雒縣令崔珪，恕之表兄，妻美，恕誘而私之，而貶珪官。

translations.literal: Shu in Sword-South had Luoxian District Captain Cui Gui — Shu's maternal cousin; wife beautiful; Shu enticed and privately took her, and demoted Gui's office.
translations.idiomatic: Shu in Sword-South had Luoxian district captain Cui Gui — Shu's maternal cousin; wife beautiful; Shu enticed and privately took her, and demoted Gui's office.

sentences.zh: 又養刺客李晏。

translations.literal: Also kept assassin Li Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Also kept assassin Li Yan.

sentences.zh: 至九載，並為人所發，贓私各數萬貫。

translations.literal: By the ninth year all were reported by others; illicit wealth each several ten thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: By the ninth year all were reported by others; illicit wealth each several ten thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 林甫奏稱璟子渾就東京臺推，恕就本使劍南推，皆有實狀，渾流嶺南高要郡，恕流海康郡。

translations.literal: Linfu memorialized saying Jing's son Hun was pushed at Eastern Capital bureau, Shu at his own commission Sword-South — all had real circumstances; Hun exiled to Lingnan Gaoyao Commandery, Shu exiled to Haikang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Linfu memorialized saying Jing's son Hun was pushed at Eastern Capital bureau, Shu at his own commission Sword-South — all had real circumstances; Hun exiled to Lingnan Gaoyao Commandery, Shu exiled to Haikang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 尚，其載又為人訟其贓，貶臨海長史。

translations.literal: Shang, that year again was sued by others for his illicit wealth, demoted to chief administrator of Linhai.
translations.idiomatic: Shang, that year again was sued by others for his illicit wealth, demoted to chief administrator of Linhai.

sentences.zh: 其子華、衡，居官皆坐贓，相次流貶。

translations.literal: His sons Hua and Heng, in office all sat for illicit wealth, successively exiled.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Hua and Heng, in office all sat for illicit wealth, successively exiled.

sentences.zh: 其後渾會赦，量移至東陽郡下，請托過求，及役使人吏，求其資課，人不堪其弊，訟之，配流潯江郡。

translations.literal: Later Hun met amnesty, quantitatively moved to Dongyang Commandery lower; requesting favors over-seeking, and employing and driving officials and clerks, seeking his tax levy — people could not bear the harm, sued; assigned exile to Xunjiang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Later Hun met amnesty, quantitatively moved to Dongyang Commandery lower; requesting favors over-seeking, and employing and driving officials and clerks, seeking his tax levy — people could not bear the harm, sued; assigned exile to Xunjiang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 然兄弟盡善飲謔，俳優雜戲，衡最粗險，廣平之風教，無復存矣。

translations.literal: Yet the brothers all excelled at drinking and jest, actors and mixed plays; Heng was most crude and dangerous — Guangping's wind and teaching, no longer existed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the brothers all excelled at drinking and jest, actors and mixed plays; Heng was most crude and dangerous — Guangping's wind and teaching, no longer existed.

sentences.zh: 廣德後，渾除太子諭德，為物議薄之，乃留寓於江嶺卒。

translations.literal: After Guangde, Hun was appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; public opinion slighted him; he then lodged at rivers and ranges and died.
translations.idiomatic: After Guangde, Hun was appointed junior tutor of the heir apparent; public opinion slighted him; he then lodged at rivers and ranges and died.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：履艱危則易見良臣，處平定則難彰賢相。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Treading danger then good ministers easily appear; dwelling in peace then hard to manifest worthy chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: Treading danger then good ministers easily appear; dwelling in peace then hard to manifest worthy chancellors.

sentences.zh: 故房、杜預創業之功，不可儔匹。

translations.literal: Therefore Fang and Du's merit in founding enterprise cannot be matched.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Fang and Du's merit in founding enterprise cannot be matched.

sentences.zh: 而姚、宋經武、韋二後，政亂刑淫，頗涉履於中，克全聲跡，抑無愧焉。

translations.literal: Yet Yao and Song after Empress Wu and Zhongzong, government chaotic punishment excessive, quite treading the middle, completely preserving fame and traces — also without shame.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Yao and Song after Empress Wu and Zhongzong, government chaotic punishment excessive, quite treading the middle, completely preserving fame and traces — also without shame.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：姚、宋入用，刑政多端。

translations.literal: Praise says: Yao and Song entered use, punishment and government many-sided.
translations.idiomatic: Praise says: Yao and Song entered use, punishment and government many-sided.

sentences.zh: 為政匪易，防刑益難。

translations.literal: Governing is not easy, guarding punishment harder still.
translations.idiomatic: Governing is not easy, guarding punishment harder still.

sentences.zh: 諫諍以猛，施張用寬。

translations.literal: Admonition and remonstrance with sternness, application and expansion with breadth.
translations.idiomatic: Admonition and remonstrance with sternness, application and expansion with breadth.

sentences.zh: 不有其道，將何以安？

translations.literal: Without their Way, how obtain peace?
translations.idiomatic: Without their Way, how obtain peace?
